quest.title: Project Baby
quest.description: Snake Handler Gulabgir seems to be in trouble...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x2000, Mora x2000, Mora x2000

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Gone again... Um... Traveler! Could you please do me a favor?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: My food is missing!

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Uh, no, that can't be it! My pet snakes' food — that's what's missing!

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you find the food?

talks.objective: Look for Gulabgir's pet snake food

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: You are back! I gotta say, that was quick. Did you find the food?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this what you're looking for?

talks.objective: Look for Gulabgir's pet snake food

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Yes, these would do! Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why weren't these in the camp, but on the nearby tree?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Well... Maybe the birds had them stashed away for a rainy day...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Is this stuff so popular with animals? Maybe I should start a business...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Ahem! Don't mind me. Thank you very much. Here's your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Yes! That's it! So I did leave it in the camp after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was buried under the rocks. Your camp seems to have gotten caught in a landslide that carried your stuff far away. We spent a long while looking, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Seriously? How could there be a landslide? That spot has never been in any trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Oh! When I was camping there, I could hear strange sounds at night, and I could feel something scratching at my tent...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: My snakes were alert and would wake me every time. But I never found anything no matter how many times I checked...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Eh, you know what, forget about it... Thanks for your help. Here's your payment.

talks.objective: Look for Gulabgir's pet snake food

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Yes! That's it! So I did leave it in the camp after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the camp...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: I see... Was it the work of wild animals...?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, the food I made attracted Fungi and birds... So, attracting wild animals sounds about right...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Guess I should really consider starting a feed-selling business...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: If that turns out well, I could be making much more money than I do now by putting up performances...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Oh, sorry, I'm getting off-topic... Thanks for your help, and please, take your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Yes! That's it! So I did leave it in the camp after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is your camp in the middle of a bunch of thorny vines!? Wouldn't you get hurt sleeping there?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Nah, I'm pretty skilled when it comes to living in the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: And there weren't that many vines around when I established that camp.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you been away from the forest for a very long time?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Sort of. I can't remember the details.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I'm really rusty when it comes to setting up camps now.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Most of the camps I've set up in the past have been abandoned.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: What kind of life would I be leading had I remained in the rainforest...?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, I've said too much. Here is your payment. Please take it.

talks.objective: Look for Gulabgir's pet snake food

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: You are back! I gotta say, that was quick. Did you find the food?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this what you're looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's special food for pet snakes? Don't they eat mice and stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Yes, they did hunt by themselves in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: But ever since they startled several children whilst feeding, I have banned them from going out without me. I've started mixing food for them.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: *sigh* But after that, they haven't been moving much, and have stubbornly refused to eat any other food.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Paimon thought "there was no such thing as a free lunch"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon hasn't even asked about the flavor yet, so you can dream on!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Enjoying food is Paimon's job!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh huh. Very reasonable of you.

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: I must have left their food at one of my camps when I was out picking herbs.

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: But I can't really leave, what with all my little fellas to care for and stuff. I don't want them scaring anyone again when they search for food...

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: Traveler, would you mind visiting that campsite and fetching the food for me?

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: Thank you so much. Who knows what accidents we might run into if I were to go there with these little fellas.

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: If they got it into their heads to go playing around in the forest for a few days, I'd be doomed...

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: Anyway, I'll be leaving this to you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: I'll mark all the camps I've stayed at on the map for you, so please take a look at those spots.

choices.text: There aren't any other snakes at the campsites, right...?

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: No, not at all. I set all my camps up away from snake lairs precisely so that we could stay out of trouble...

choices.text: How many camps have you got, again?

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: Well, I set up a few while I was living in the rainforest.

response.speaker: Gulabgir
response.text: I've already stopped living in the rainforest, but I still do rest at my campsites if I collect herbs there.

talks.objective: Look for Gulabgir's pet snake food

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's sure we've met someone with a snake for a pet before... Right! It's that weirdo named Baizhu...

choices.text: I don't think Changsheng counts as a "pet"...

choices.text: Changsheng would get mad at you for saying that.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Yes! That's it! So I did leave it in the camp after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When we arrived, there were Fungi that were trying to swipe it.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Fungi, huh... Phew, guess I was lucky to have you go instead. Thank you so much, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: I can't thank you enough. Please, accept this as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Here's your meal, little fellas...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: What's the matter? Anything else on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found something else in the camp.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Huh? This bead... How... Where did you find this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Inside a pot in the camp. Did you leave that behind?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Ah, it was used in past shows. Whenever I play the flute, my little fellas would carry that bead on their heads and dance with their upper bodies in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: But tricks of this kind have long ceased being profitable, and I haven't performed for quite some time either. I didn't even notice that it had gone missing...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Anyway, thanks for bringing it back. Here's your payment, please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: What's the matter? Anything else on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found something else in the camp.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Huh? These hats... Hahaha, I made them for the snakes. How did I even forget these?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: I made each of them a nightcap so that they could attract children to the show.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Red for Jori, green for Amum, yellow for Gana, and blue for Drak...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds cute! The show must've been a hit!

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: It went well at first, but the children would burst into tears whenever the snakes opened their jaws...

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Oh, forget about it... Please take this as your payment. It's something, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: What's the matter? Anything else on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found something else in the camp.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Ah! Isn't this the snake climbing tower I made? Wow, this sure brings back some memories! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Snake climbing tower? What even is that?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Just a toy for the snakes to climb on. I can't have them hanging on me all the time, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing it back. Please take this as your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Gulabgir
dialogues.text: So I designed it like that? Hah, this sure does bring back some memories...
